actions.update_custom_field.props.name.d: New name, unique in the workspace. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_custom_field.props.precis: Number fields only: digits after the decimal point, 0 to 6. Leave empty to keep it.
Rename, recolor, disable or re-enable an option of an Asana select custom field (paid Asana plans only).
New Asana option color name, for example red, green, blue or none. Leave empty to keep it.
Yes to make the option selectable again, No to disable (retire) it. Leave empty to keep the current state.
Gid of the option to update. Obtain it from Get Custom Field (enum_options).
New label. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_project.description: Change fields of an existing Asana project.
actions.update_project.props.archived.de: Yes archives the project, No unarchives it. Leave empty to keep the current state.
actions.update_project.props.color.descr: New project color. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_project.props.default_vie: New default view. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_project.props.due_on.desc: New due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
actions.update_project.props.name.descri: New project name. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_project.props.notes.descr: New plain-text description; replaces the current one. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_project.props.owner.descr: New owner: "me", an email address or a user gid. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_project.props.privacy_set: New privacy setting. Making a project private hides it from non-members. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_project.props.project.des: Gid of the project to update. Obtain it from List Projects or Search Workspace Objects.
actions.update_project.props.start_on.de: New start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The project must have a due date.
actions.update_project_brief.description: Change the title or body of an Asana project brief.
actions.update_project_brief.props.html_: New body in Asana rich text, wrapped in <body>...</body>. Cannot be combined with Text.
actions.update_project_brief.props.proje: Gid of the project brief. Obtain it from the project_brief field of Get Project.
New plain-text body. Cannot be combined with HTML Text.
actions.update_project_brief.props.title: New title. Leave empty to keep it.
Title
actions.update_section.props.name.descri: New name of the section. Cannot be empty.
actions.update_section.props.section.des: Gid of the section. Obtain it from List Sections.
actions.update_tag.description: Rename or recolor an Asana tag.
actions.update_tag.props.color.descripti: New color. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_tag.props.name.descriptio: New name. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_tag.props.notes.descripti: New description; replaces the current one. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_tag.props.tag.description: Gid of the tag. Obtain it from List Tags or Search Workspace Objects.
actions.update_task.description: Change fields of an existing Asana task.
actions.update_task.props.assignee.descr: New assignee: "me", an email address or a user gid. Leave empty to keep the current assignee.
actions.update_task.props.completed.desc: Yes marks the task complete, No reopens it. Leave empty to keep the current state.
actions.update_task.props.due_at.descrip: New exact due moment as an ISO 8601 date-time that ends in Z (UTC) or a +hh:mm/-hh:mm offset, for example 2026-10-15T17:00:00Z or 2026-10-15T19:00:00+02:00; a value without an offset is rejected. Cannot be combined with Due Date.
actions.update_task.props.due_on.descrip: New all-day due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Cannot be combined with Due Date and Time.
actions.update_task.props.html_notes.des: New rich-text description wrapped in <body>...</body>; replaces the whole current description. Cannot be combined with Description.
actions.update_task.props.name.descripti: New title of the task. Leave empty to keep the current name.
actions.update_task.props.notes.descript: New plain-text description; replaces the whole current description. Cannot be combined with HTML Description. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_task.props.start_on.descr: New start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The task must have (or get) a due date.
actions.update_task.props.task.descripti: Gid of the task to update. Obtain it from List Project Tasks, List Assigned Tasks or Search Workspace Objects.
actions.update_team.description: Change the name, description, visibility or endorsement of an Asana team.
actions.update_team.props.description.de: New plain-text description; replaces the current one. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_team.props.endorsed.descr: Yes to mark the team as endorsed, No to remove the endorsement. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_team.props.name.descripti: New team name. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_team.props.team.descripti: Gid of the team to update. Obtain it from List Teams or List User Teams.
actions.update_team.props.visibility.des: New visibility; empty keeps it. Secret may need a paid plan.
actions.update_user.description: Set a user's profile custom fields (or your own name) in an Asana workspace (higher Asana plans only).
Map of custom field gid to new value, for example 1201234567890 = "Berlin office". Leave empty to keep them.
actions.update_user.props.name.descripti: New display name. Asana only accepts this for the connected user ("me"). Leave empty to keep it.
actions.update_user.props.user.descripti: User to update: "me", an email address or a user gid.
actions.update_user.props.workspace.desc: Gid of the workspace whose user profile to update. Obtain it from List Workspaces.
actions.upload_attachment.description: Upload a file, or attach a link, to an Asana task, project or project brief.
actions.upload_attachment.props.file.des: The file to upload (up to 100 MB). Leave empty when attaching an External URL.
actions.upload_attachment.props.name.des: Display name of the attachment. Required with External URL; for a File it replaces the file name.
actions.upload_attachment.props.parent.d: Gid of the task, project or project brief to attach to. Obtain a task gid from List Project Tasks or Get Task, a project gid from List Projects.
actions.upload_attachment.props.url.desc: An http(s) link to attach instead of a file. Requires Name. Leave empty when uploading a File.
description: Work management platform designed to help teams organize, track, and manage their work.
